recipes.name: Chicken Pot Pie
recipes.ingredients:
1 ½ cups cooked and shredded chicken or 1 can premium white chunk chicken breast
1 can cream of chicken soup or cream of potato soup
1 can mixed vegetables drained
2 refrigerated pie crusts
1 tsp chicken bouillon such as Maggi Caldo Sabor a Pollo
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375° F.
Mix all ingredients together and pour into pie pan.
Cover with the refrigerated pie crusts, pinching the edges together.
Make several slits in the top of the crusts. Cover the edges of the pies with foil to keep them from burning.
Bake on the middle rack for approximately 1 hour.

recipes.name: Chex Mix
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups each Corn, Rice and Wheat Chex cereal
1 cup mixed nuts
1 cup bite-size pretzels
1 cup garlic-flavor bite-size bagel chips or regular-size bagel chips broken into 1-inch pieces
6 tablespoons butter or margarine
2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce
1½ teaspoons seasoned salt
3/4 teaspoon garlic powder
1/½ teaspoon onion powder
recipes.instructions:
In large microwavable bowl, mix cereals, nuts, pretzels and bagel chips; set aside.
In small microwavable bowl, microwave butter uncovered on High about 40 seconds or until melted. Stir in seasonings. Pour over cereal mixture; stir until evenly coated.
Microwave uncovered on High 5 to 6 minutes, thoroughly stirring every 2 minutes. Spread on paper towels to cool. Store in airtight container.

Oven Prep: Heat oven to 250°F. In large bowl, mix cereals, nuts, pretzels and bagel chips; set aside. In ungreased large roasting pan, melt butter in oven. Stir in seasonings. Gradually stir in cereal mixture until evenly coated. Bake 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes. Spread on paper towels to cool, about 15 minutes.
Store in air tight container

recipes.name: Chicken Fajita Mac and Cheese
recipes.ingredients:
Fajita Seasoning Mix (1x)
1 Tsp Salt
1 Tsp Oregano
1 Tsp Garlic Powder
1 Tsp Onion Powder
1 Tsp Paprika
1 Tsp Chilli Powder
1 Tsp Cumin
Chicken Marinade
750g Cubed Raw Chicken Breast (I get mine from @saffron_alley)
5x Fajita Seasoning Mix
2 Tsp Olive Oil
1 Whole Lime Juice
20g Light Butter (for cooking)
Fajita Mac n Cheese
1/2 White Onion finely chopped
1/2 Red Onion finely chopped
1/2 Red Bell Pepper finely chopped
1/2 Green Bell Pepper finely chopped
1/2 or 0.5x Fajita Seasoning mix
280ml any milk of you choice
150g Light Cream Cheese
35g Light Cheddar grated
35g Mozzarella
240g Uncooked Macaroni / 530g Cooked Macaroni
1/2 Lime Juice

recipes.name: Baked Pear Custard Tart
recipes.ingredients:
Cooking oil spray
4 eggs
1 1/4 cup thickened low-fat cream
1 tsp vanilla extract
3 tbsp honey
3 tbsp plain whole wheat flour
2 pears (or 2 apples)
½ tsp cinnamon
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 320 degrees fahrenheit and lightly grease a pie pan with cooking oil.
Mix eggs, honey, cream and vanilla in a bowl, beating well to make the custard filling.
Whisk in sifted flour, then pour 2/3 of this mix into the greased pie dish and bake for 5 to 7 minutes to set the custard.
Cut pears or apples into thin slices while the filling bakes.
Remove pie pan from the oven and scatter fruit slices on top.
Pour remaining custard cream over the fruit and sprinkle generously with cinnamon.
Return to the oven and bake for another 15 minutes or until custard has set.

recipes.name: Hamburger Goo
recipes.ingredients:
1 pound ground beef
1 cup cut-up celery
1/2 cup chopped onion
1 tablespoon brown sugar
2 tablespoons vinegar
1/2 teaspoon dry mustard
3/4 cup ketchup
2 tablespoons flour
6 sandwich buns
recipes.instructions:
Brown in a skillet over medium heat. Pour off the fat.
Add
Sprinkle on the mixture. Stir to mix well. Simmer for about 20 minutes.
Cut in half and put them together with the beef mixture in between. Makes 6 sandwiches.

recipes.name: Cheesy Beef and Potato Hash
recipes.ingredients:
2 medium russet potatoes
3 tablespoons olive oil
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
1 small onion, chopped
1 red bell pepper, chopped
1 clove garlic, minced
8 ounces ground beef (90% lean)
1/2 teaspoon chili powder
1 1/2 cups grated sharp Cheddar
recipes.instructions:
Peel the potatoes and cut into small cubes (a little less than 1/2 inch). Put in a bowl and cover with cold water, mixing to rinse off the starch. Drain and rinse in a colander, then transfer to paper towels and pat dry.
Heat the oil in a 10-inch cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat. Add the potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and golden brown on most sides, about 15 minutes. Season with 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper to taste, then transfer to a plate with a slotted spoon.
Preheat the broiler on high.
Add the onion, bell pepper and garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, about 7 minutes. Add the beef, chili powder and 1/2 teaspoon salt and cook, breaking up any clumps with a wooden spoon, until brown, about 5 minutes. Return the potatoes to the skillet and mix to combine. Sprinkle the cheese over the hash.
Broil until melted and bubbling, about 1 minute.

recipes.name: Crispy Smashed Potatoes
recipes.ingredients:
1 ½ pounds small gold potatoes
Spoonful of salt
2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
1 teaspoon garlic powder
Lots of freshly ground salt and pepper, to taste
recipes.instructions:
Add the potatoes and salt to a large pot of water and bring to a boil.
Cook the potatoes until just fork-tender, about 15-20 minutes, then drain, allowing them to cool for 5 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 450 degrees.
In a small bowl, or ziplock mix together the olive oil and garlic powder and coat the potatoes with oil. Place the potatoes on a cooking sheet and season them generously with salt and pepper.
Use a heavy bottomed pot, large mug or another sheet pan to smash the potatoes until they’re about 1/3 inch thick and flat on two sides. Note: don’t make them too thin or they’ll be likely to fall apart easier.
Bake in the oven for 40-45 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the potatoes are nice and golden and crispy to your liking.

recipes.name: Mom's Potato Salad
recipes.ingredients:
8 Potatoes, boiled, baked, or microwaved; may be peeled or not
6 Hard boiled eggs
1 cup Celery
1 medium Onion, diced
1 cup chopped Pickles or relish
5 cups Mayo or plain Greek yogurt
.25 cup Mustard
Salt
Paprika
recipes.instructions:
Chop potatoes, eggs, celery, onion, and pickles.
Add mayo and prepared mustard and salt to taste.
Toss and taste.
Decorate with some of the egg halves & paprika
Cover with plastic wrap so it doesn't flavor other foods.
Chill for 24 hours in the refrigerator for best flavor.

recipes.name: Red Beans and Rice
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups uncooked white long grain rice
1 tablespoon butter
4 strips bacon
2 15 oz cans red beans
1/4 cup water
1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
1/2 teaspoon onion powder
1 teaspoon creole seasoning
1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke
recipes.instructions:
In a large saucepan or pot, bring 4 cups of water to a boil. Add rice and butter and lower to a simmer. Cover and cook for 15-20 minutes or until rice is cooked.
Add chopped bacon to a large deep skillet or saucepan. Cook over medium heat and stir until bacon starts to crisp. ( If you don't want bacon in the beans, carefully remove the bacon bits but leave the bacon grease. )
Pour in whole cans of red beans. Using a potato masher, mash some of the beans but leave some of them whole.
Pour in water, garlic salt, onion powder, creole seasoning, and liquid smoke. Stir to combine.
Let simmer for 15 minutes or until beans start to soften. Make sure to stir so that the beans don't stick.

recipes.name: Vanilla Ice Cream
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups milk
1 3/4 cups sugar
1/2 teaspoon salt
2 cups half and half
1 tablespoon vanilla extract
4 cups whipping cream
recipes.instructions:
Remove from heat and stir in until dissolved
Add and stir together
Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Pour into the ice cream maker and follow manufacturer directions until frozen.
Strawberry: Add pureed strawberries (4 cups for 4 quart, 5 cups for quart, or 6 cups for 6 quart) to chilled mixture before freezing.
Banana: Add mashed bananas (3 cups for 4 quart, 3½ cups for 5 quart, or 4 cups for 6 quart) to the chilled mixture before freezing.
Peach: Add pureed peaches (4 cups for 4 quart, 5 cups for 5 quan 6 cups for 6 quart) to the chilled mixture before freezing.
recipes.notes:
Scald until bubbles form around the edge of the pan
Ice
Rock salt

recipes.name: Funeral Potatoes
recipes.ingredients:
30 ounces frozen hash browns, diced or shredded will work, THAWED*
2 cups sour cream
5 ounce can cream of chicken soup (or homemade)
10 Tablespoons butter , divided, melted
1 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
1 teaspoon dried minced onion
2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
2 cups corn flakes cereal
recipes.instructions:
Allow potatoes to thaw in your fridge overnight, or spread them on a baking sheet and warm them in the oven at 200 degrees for about 20 minutes, until thawed.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Combine sour cream, cream of chicken soup, 6 Tablespoons of melted butter, salt, pepper and dried onion in a bowl. Mix well.
Add potatoes and shredded cheese and stir to combine.
Spoon mixture into a single layer in a 9x13'' pan.
Add cornflakes to a large ziplock bag and crush gently with your hands or a rolling pin.
Add remaining 4 tablespoons of melted butter to the crushed cornflakes and combine well. Sprinkle mixture over potatoes.
Bake uncovered at 350 F for 40-50 minutes.

recipes.name: Easy Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.ingredients:
5 oz canned cooked chicken
2 cups chopped white onions
1/4 cup light sour cream
1/4 cup nonfat mayonnaise
14 oz chicken broth
1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese, divided
6 8-inch flour tortillas
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 deg
Combine sour cream, mayonnaise, and chicken broth.
Spray a 9-inch square baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Fill each tortilla with chicken, onion and a portion of 1 cup of the cheese. Roll tortilla around filling and place in prepared baking dish. Repeat with remaining tortillas.
Pour sour cream mixture over filled tortillas. Sprinkle top with remaining cheese.
Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake at 375 degrees F. for 20 to 25 minutes

recipes.name: Tortellini Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb Italian Sausage
3/4 cup white onion diced
2 stalks celery thinly sliced
2 medium carrots peeled, halved and sliced
6 cups chicken broth
28 ounce can crushed tomatoes
15 ounce can white beans drained and rinsed
19 ounce package refrigerated cheese tortellini
3 cups baby spinach
2 tablespoons chopped parsley
recipes.instructions:
Cook
Add
recipes.notes:
Saute
salt and pepper to taste

recipes.name: Meatloaf
recipes.ingredients:
½ cups soft bread crumbs
¾ cup milk
2 pounds ground beef
2 teaspoons salt
⅛ teaspoon pepper
1 medium carrot, peeled and grated
1 small onion, peeled and minced
2 eggs, beaten
Topping:
½ cup ketchup
3 tablespoons brown sugar
2 tablespoons prepared mustard
recipes.instructions:
Start heating the oven to 325° F.
Put the bread crumbs in a large bowl and pour the milk over them.
Stir in the ground beef, salt, pepper, grated carrot, onion and beaten eggs. Mix thoroughly with a spoon or fork.
Lightly shape the meat-loaf mixture with your hands to make an oval loaf. Put it in a shallow baking pan, such as a 13×9×2-inch pan. Gently smooth the loaf to make it even and neatly shaped. The loaf will be juicier if you handle the mixture very little.
Mix the ketchup, brown sugar and mustard and spread it over the top of the loaf.
Bake it for 1 ½ hours.
Remove the meat loaf from the oven. Loosen the bottom of the loaf from the pan and lift it onto a warm platter with a wide spatula. Slice to serve. It is good hot or cold. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.name: Kneader's Overnight French Toast
recipes.ingredients:
1 Loaf Kneaders Chunky Cinnamon Bread, Loaf Ends Removed
8 Large Eggs
3 Cups Milk
1 Tablespoon Brown Sugar
1 Tablespoon Vanilla
3/4 Teaspoon Salt
2 Tablespoons Butter, Divided
recipes.instructions:
Generously Butter A 9x13-Inch Baking Dish With 1 T. Of Butter. Slice Bread Into 8 Pieces.
Lay 6 Slices Of Bread In Baking Dish. Cut Remaining Two Slices Into Smaller Pieces To Fill Gaps.
Whisk Eggs. Add Milk, Brown Sugar, Salt, & Vanilla In A Mixing Bowl. Pour Mixture Over Bread.
Cover & Refrigerate Overnight, Or For At Least 4 Hours.
Cut Remaining 1 T. Of Butter Into Small Pieces. Dot Bread With Butter.
Bake Uncovered For 45-50 Minutes At 350°f.
Enjoy Warm With Sliced Strawberries & Whipped Cream. Drizzle With Kneaders Famous Caramel Syrup

recipes.name: Bryon Miller’s Barbecued Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
½ small minced onion
Butter 1/8 lb.
Water 1 C
Vinegar 1/2 C
Dry Mustard ¾ t
Sugar 1 T
Salt 1 t
Chili powder ½ t
Black pepper ½ t
Paprika ½ t
Onion salt 1 t ( or onion flakes)
Garlic salt ½ t ( or garlic)
Worcestershire sauce 1 ½ t
Tabasco sauce 1 ½ t
½ cup of concentrated apple juice
recipes.instructions:
Saute onion in butter
Combine ingredients
Boil for one hour
Marinate or baste chicken. 
Cook chicken faster by first baking in the oven with sauce about an hour then grilling chicken and basting with sauce
recipes.notes:
For 10 chicken halves
½ lb. briquettes per chicken

recipes.name: Andes Crème de Menthe Chunk Cookies
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 cup salted butter - softened
3/4 cup dark brown sugar
1/2 cup white granulated sugar
1 tsp. baking soda
1 tsp. baking powder
2 tsp. vanilla extract
2 eggs
1 package (10 oz.) Andes Crème de Menthe Baking Chips
2 2/3 cups sifted all purpose flour
recipes.instructions:
Beat butter, sugars, baking soda, baking powder, vanilla and eggs until mixed.
Stir in Andes Baking Chips then flour.
Chill approximately one hour in refrigerator.
Measure out approximately 1 oz. dough. Form ball and slightly flatten.
Raise oven rack one level above middle and bake on non-stick baking pans.
Bake at 350° F for approximately 8-10 minutes.
Cool on pans for two minutes before removing.

recipes.name: Apple Pie
recipes.ingredients:
6 to 7 cups sliced, peeled apples (6 to 7 medium apples)
3/4 to 1 cup sugar
2 tablespoons flour
1/2 to 1 teaspoon cinnamon
1/8 teaspoon nutmeg
1/8 teaspoon salt
2 tablespoons butter
recipes.instructions:
Use Pastry Made with Solid Fat, Pastry Made with Oil or Beginner's Pastry for a 2-crust pie. Mix pastry by recipe directions. Form it into a ball and cut it in half with a knife. Roll the bottom crust and line a 9-inch pie pan with it, as the directions tell you. Put the pastry-lined pan in the refrigerator while you fix the filling. Set the other half of the pastry aside.
Cut apples in quarters, cut out the cores and cut the apples into slices 1/4 inch thick. Place them in a large bowl.
Stir the sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt to- gether to mix well. (The amount of sugar-3/4 to 1 cup -you need to add depends on the tartness of the apples, and the amount of cinnamon-1/2 to 1 teaspoon-depends on how spicy you like apple pie.) Add the mixture to the apple slices and toss with 2 forks to mix well.
Start heating the oven to 425° F.
Roll the other half of the pastry for the top crust and cut small vents in it.
Place the apple mixture in the pastry-lined pie pan and spread it evenly. Dot it with butter.
Cover the apples with the top crust. Gently press the top and bottom crusts together. Then fold the edge of the lower crust over the edge of the top crust. Use a fork to make a pretty design on the edge of the pie, or flute edge with a pinch and twist of your thumb and forefinger. Then cover the edge of the pie with a 1/2-inch strip of aluminum foil to prevent it from browning too much. (Remove the foil after the pie is baked.)
Bake on the rack in the center of the oven 50 to 60 minutes or until the crust is browned. Cool the pie on a wire rack. Serve it warm or cold. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.name: Brown Sugar and Pineapple Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
4 boneless, skinless chicken thighs or breasts
Salt and pepper to taste
1 tablespoon olive oil
1 cup pineapple chunks (fresh or canned, drained)
1/2 cup pineapple juice
1/3 cup brown sugar
2 tablespoons soy sauce
2 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 teaspoon ground ginger
1 tablespoon cornstarch + 2 tablespoons water (optional, for thickening)
Fresh parsley or green onions for garnish (optional)
recipes.instructions:
Season chicken with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chicken on both sides until browned, about 4-5 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, add pineapple chunks, pineapple juice, brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic, and ground ginger. Stir well and bring to a gentle simmer.
Return the chicken to the skillet, spoon some sauce over the top, and cover. Reduce heat to low and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and tender.
(Optional) For a thicker sauce, mix cornstarch and water in a small bowl, then stir into the pan. Simmer until thickened, about 2-3 minutes.

recipes.name: Easy Homemade Pizza Dough
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup warm water
1 Tablespoon granulated sugar
1 Tablespoon active dry yeast
1 Tablespoon olive oil
2 to 2 ½ cups all-purpose flour*
1 tsp fine sea salt
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 500 degrees F.
Combine 1 cup warm water, 1 Tbl yeast and 1 Tbl sugar in a large mixing bowl and stir to combine.
Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes, or until it becomes frothy and bubbles form.
Gently stir in 1 Tbl olive oil.
Add 2 cups of flour and salt and mix with a spatula until a ball begins to form (dough will still be slightly sticky). Add more flour as needed to form a dough ball.
Transfer to a floured surface and knead into a smooth dough, adding up to ½ cup extra flour if needed.
Optional. If desired, cover the bowl with a damp tea towel and let it rise for 10 minutes or up to 1 hour.
Roll the dough into your desired shape and put it on a piece of parchment paper.
Add pizza sauce, cheese and toppings of choice.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the bottom of the crust is golden brown.
Remove the pizza from the oven and cool for at least 5-10 minutes before cutting and serving.

recipes.name: German Pancakes
recipes.ingredients:
4 Tbs. butter or margarine
6 eggs
1 C. flour
1 C. milk
¼ tsp. salt
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 450°F
Put 2 Tbs. butter in each of two pie pans; melt as oven preheats.
In a bowl, combine eggs(6), flour(1 C.), milk(1 C.), and salt(¼ tsp.); beat until fluffy and smooth.
Pour half of batter in each pan
Bake at 450°F for 20 minutes. Pancakes will puff up.

recipes.name: Oatmeal Cookies
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/4 Cup(s) (2-1/2 sticks) margarine or butter, softened
3/4 Cup(s) firmly packed brown sugar
1/2 Cup(s) granulated sugar
1 Egg(s)
1 Teaspoon(s) vanilla
1 1/2 Cup(s) all-purpose flour
1 Teaspoon(s) Baking Soda
1 Teaspoon(s) ground cinnamon
1/2 Teaspoon(s) salt (optional)
1/4 Teaspoon(s) ground nutmeg
3 Cup(s) Quaker® Oats (quick or old fashioned, uncooked)
recipes.instructions:
Heat oven to 375°F.
In large bowl, beat margarine and sugars until creamy.
Add egg and vanilla; beat well.
Add combined flour, baking soda, cinnamon, salt and nutmeg; mix well.
Add oats; mix well.
Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake 8 to 9 minutes for a chewy cookie or 10 to 11 minutes for a crisp cookie.
Cool 1 minute on cookie sheets; remove to wire rack.
Cool completely.
Store tightly covered.

recipes.name: Onion dip
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup sour cream (full-fat is recommended for best texture)
1 tablespoon dried minced onion (also called dehydrated chopped onion)
1 teaspoon onion powder
¼ teaspoon garlic powder
1 teaspoon dried parsley (optional, for color and slight herby-ness)
Salt and black pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine Ingredients: In a medium-sized bowl, combine the sour cream, dried minced onion, onion powder, garlic powder, and dried parsley (if using).
Mix Well: Stir all the ingredients together thoroughly until the spices are evenly distributed throughout the sour cream.
Season: Taste the mixture and add salt and pepper as needed to achieve your desired flavor profile.
Chill: Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving. This crucial step allows the dehydrated onions to rehydrate and the flavors to fully meld together.
Serve: Give the dip one final stir before serving with your favorite dippers, such as potato chips, crackers, or fresh vegetables.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Pudding Dessert
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup all-purpose flour
½ cup cold butter, cubed
1½ cups chopped cashews, divided
1 package (8 ounces) cream cheese, softened
⅓ cup creamy peanut butter
1 cup confectioners' sugar
1 carton (12 ounces) frozen whipped topping, thawed, divided
2⅔ cups cold 2% milk
1 package (3.9 ounces) instant chocolate pudding mix
1 package (3.4 ounces) instant vanilla pudding mix
1 milk chocolate candy bar (1.55 ounces), coarsely chopped
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 350°
Place flour(1 C.) and butter(½ C) in a food processor; cover and process until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add 1 cup cashews; pulse a few times until combined.
Press into a greased 13x9-in. baking dish.
Bake until golden brown, 25-28 minutes. Cool completely on a wire rack.
In a small bowl, beat the cream cheese, peanut butter and confectioners' sugar until smooth. Fold in 1 cup whipped topping.
Spoon mixture over the crust.
In another bowl, whisk milk and both pudding mixes for 2 minutes. Let stand until soft-set, about 2 minutes.
Spread the cream cheese layer. Top with remaining whipped topping.
Sprinkle with chopped candy bar and remaining cashews.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.name: Pear Squares
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup brown sugar
1/2 cup margarine or butter, softened
2 eggs
2 cups pears, diced and drained (peaches or pineapple may be substituted)
1/4 cup juice
2 cups flour
1 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon soda
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350°
Add and continue beating
Sift together and add to the creamed butter
Pour batter into a 9" x 13" pan
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.name: Zuppa Toscana
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb. Hot Italian sausage, casings removed
1 large onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
kosher salt
Freshly ground black pepper
6 cups low-sodium chicken broth
4 large russet potatoes, diced
1 bunch curly kale, leaves stripped and chopped
3/4 cup heavy cream
4 slices cooked bacon, chopped
1/4 freshly grated Parmesan, for serving
recipes.instructions:
In a large pot over medium heat, cook sausage, breaking up with the back of a wooden spoon, until browned and no longer pink, 5 to 7 minutes. Transfer to a plate to drain.
Add onion to pot and let cook until soft, 5 minutes, then add garlic and cook until fragrant, 1 minute more. Season with salt and pepper. Add chicken broth and potatoes and cook until potatoes are tender, 23 to 25 minutes.
Stir in kale and let cook until leaves are tender and bright green, 3 minutes, then stir in heavy cream, sausage, and bacon and simmer 5 minutes more.
Season with pepper, garnish with Parmesan, and serve.

recipes.name: Apple Cobbler with Bisquick
recipes.ingredients:
3 large apples or 4-5 medium to small apples
¾ cup brown sugar light or dark
1 teaspoon cinnamon divided
1 cup Bisquick or other baking mix
¾ cup milk whole, 2%, 1% or skim
2 Tablespoons sugar
½ cup butter salted or unsalted, melted
recipes.instructions:
Peel and cut apples into bite sized pieces. Toss with brown sugar and ½ teaspoon cinnamon and set aside.
Combine Bisquick, milk, remaining cinnamon, sugar and melted butter until well blended with no lumps.
Pour batter into a prepared 9" pan (or similar size) and top with apples, adding the apples gently.
Bake at 375℉ for 40-45 minutes or until golden brown. Let cook slightly before serving.

recipes.name: Baked Apple Fritters
recipes.ingredients:
1 cups Flour
1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
1/4 teaspoon salt:
¼ cup Sugar
¾ cup Cinnamon Applesauce if plain, add 2 tsp. cinnamon (note 3)
1 cup Green Apple Cubes peeled, cored, diced in small cubes
Glazing
3/4 cups Confectioners Sugar
1-1½  tablespoons Milk
½ teaspoon Vanilla Extract
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 400 °F (200 °C).
Line two large baking sheets with silicone mats or baking paper that are safe for use with an oven broiler. You can also use the baking sheet directly, but it gets hard to clean. Oil the paper generously with cooking oil. Set aside.
In a mixing bowl, add flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon (if your applesauce is not cinnamon-flavored), and sugar. Whisk to combine.
Fold in applesauce and stir until it forms a thick, moist batter. Don't over-mix.
Fold in chopped apples and stir to incorporate evenly.
Drop heaping tablespoons of batter on the baking sheet, leaving a thumb space between each fritter. Don't make big fritters; for the best texture, keep them small.
Place it in the center rack of the oven, one baking sheet at a time, keeping the second one on the kitchen countertop while the first one bakes. Bake the fritters for 18-21 minutes or until nicely golden brown.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and turn the oven to broiler 420 °F (210 °C)—no more, as baking paper can't handle broiler over 425 °F!
Meanwhile, make the glazing, stir icing sugar, vanilla extract, and almond milk.
For crispy baked apple fritters, brush a little bit of the glazing on top of each warm fritter and broil on the top rack of the oven for 2-3 minutes, keeping a close eye on them so they don't burn.
When golden brown, remove from the oven. Let them cool for 10 minutes on a rack, then dip them in the glaze and return them to the rack to let the excess glazing drip down.

recipes.name: Bean soup
recipes.ingredients:
4 strips of uncooked bacon, chopped
1 medium onion, diced
1 Tbsp garlic, minced
½ tsp cayenne pepper
1 ham hock
6 cups chicken broth
1 pound dry pinto beans, soaked (see note)
¾ tsp kosher salt
recipes.instructions:
Turn your Instant Pot to the saute setting. When the display says HOT add in the chopped bacon and cook it until it is crispy. Use a slotted spoon to remove the bacon and set it aside.
Add the onions into the pot and saute the onions in the bacon grease for about 5 minutes. Add in the garlic and saute for about 20 seconds. Turn off the Instant Pot.
Add in the bacon, cayenne pepper, ham hock, chicken broth and pinto beans.
Cover the pot and secure the lid. Make sure valve is set to sealing. Set the manual/pressure cook button to 20 minutes. When time is up let the pot sit for 10 minutes and then move the valve to venting. Remove the lid.
Stir in the salt. Add in pepper to taste. Shred off any meat you can from the ham hock.
Ladle into bowls

recipes.name: Beef Barley Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 pounds boneless beef chuck, cut into cubes
1 tablespoon vegetable oil
1 cup finely chopped onion
1 cup diced carrots
1/2 cup chopped celery
3 garlic cloves, minced
1/2 teaspoon dried thyme
2 cans (14 ounces each) chicken broth (you could use 1 can chicken broth and 1 can beef broth)
2 cups water
1/2 cup medium pearl barley
chopped parsley, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
In a large soup pot, heat the oil. Add the meat and cook until browned on all sides. Remove to a plate.
Add the onions, carrots and celery to the pot. Cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and thyme and cook 30 seconds.
Pour in the broth, water and barley. Season with salt and pepper. Put the meat back into the pot. Cover and simmer about 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Taste and add more salt and pepper, if needed. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Biscuits
recipes.ingredients:
25 cups all-purpose flour
5 tablespoon baking powder
1 teaspoons granulated sugar
38 teaspoon salt
25 cup unsalted butter
5 cup whole milk or buttermilk (or ½ cup of each)
milk, buttermilk, cream or melted butter optional, for brushing on biscuit tops
recipes.instructions:
Place butter in the freezer for at least 20 minutes.
Preheat oven to 425° F with a rack in the upper third of the oven. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Whisk together until well combined.
Grate the frozen butter using a box grater. Add the butter to the bowl and use a fork to mix it into the dry ingredients.
Pour the 1 cup milk or buttermilk into the bowl and use a fork to stir until the dough comes together. It is ok if there are a few bits of flour not yet incorporated, but if the dough seems very dry and is not coming together add 1 to 2 tablespoons more milk or buttermilk.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured work surface. Pat the dough into a 1½-inch thick rectangle. Fold the dough in half on top of itself and pat it down into another 1½-inch thick rectangle. Repeat the folding process 4 to 6 times. Then press the dough down into a 1-inch thick rectangle.
Use a biscuit cutter (mine measures 2 ¼-inches) to cut out the biscuits, pressing it straight down into the dough without twisting. Once you've cut out as many biscuits as you can, gather the scraps and pat the dough out to 1-inch thickness a second and third time to finish cutting out all of the biscuits. Place them on the prepared baking sheet.
If desired, brush the biscuit tops with milk, buttermilk, cream or melted butter. Bake for 13 to 16 minutes, until the tops are lightly golden brown.

recipes.name: Blueberry Cobbler
recipes.ingredients:
6 Tablespoons butter
4 cups blueberries (fresh or frozen)
1/2 cup granulated sugar
1 teaspoon lemon zest
1 cup all-purpose flour
1 cup granulated sugar
2 teaspoons baking powder
1/4 teaspoon salt
3/4 cup milk
ground cinnamon
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Slice butter into pieces and add to a 9x13 inch baking dish. Place the pan in the oven while it preheats, to allow the butter to melt. Once melted, remove the pan from the oven.
Add blueberries, sugar and zest to a bowl and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl mix together the batter ingredients: flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Stir in the milk, just until combined.
Pour blueberries over melted butter in pan. Drizzle batter over the top. Sprinkle with a little bit of cinnamon.
Bake at 350 degrees for about 35-40 minutes, or until lightly golden on top.

recipes.name: Blueberry Cottage Cheese Breakfast Bake
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup cottage cheese
1 cup rolled oats
1 cup fresh blueberries
2 large eggs
1/4 cup honey or maple syrup
1 teaspoon cinnamon
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1/2 teaspoon baking powder (optional)
recipes.instructions:
Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease an 8×8-inch baking dish or individual ramekins.
For a smooth texture, blend the cottage cheese, oats, eggs, honey or maple syrup, vanilla extract, and cinnamon in a blender or food processor until creamy. For a chunkier texture, whisk all ingredients together in a bowl without blending.
Gently fold in the fresh blueberries.
Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish.
Bake for 25–30 minutes, or until the top is set and golden brown.
Let it cool for 5 minutes before serving. Enjoy warm, as-is, or topped with yogurt, nuts, or extra honey.
Cooking Time: 30 minutes
Calories per serving: Approximately 200 kcal

recipes.name: Blueberry Fluffy Cottage Cheese Bread Recipe
recipes.ingredients:
4 large eggs: You must separate the yolks from the whites.
1/2 cup of cottage cheese
1 tablespoon of cornstarch
2-4 tablespoons of honey
1/4 teaspoon of cream of tartar
1/2 cup of fresh blueberries
A pinch of salt
recipes.instructions:
Preparing the Mixture:
Preheat your oven to 300°F (150°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Blend cottage cheese: In a blender, blend the cottage cheese until smooth. This is crucial for a consistent texture in the bread.
Separate your eggs: Carefully separate the egg whites from the yolks, ensuring no yolk gets into the whites.
Beat the egg whites: Add the cream of tartar to the egg whites and beat them using a mixer on high speed until stiff peaks form. This may take a few minutes.
Mix yolks and cottage cheese: To the blended cottage cheese, add the egg yolks, cornstarch, sweetener, and a pinch of salt. Blend until you achieve a smooth mixture.
Combining It All:
Fold in the egg whites: Gently fold the egg white mixture into the cottage cheese mixture using a spatula. Be gentle to keep the mixture as fluffy as possible.
Add blueberries: Carefully fold in the blueberries once your base is fluffy and well-combined to avoid crushing them.
Baking:
Shape the bread: With a spoon, create 4-6 bread-like shapes on the lined baking sheet. Make sure they’re evenly spaced apart.
Bake: Place the baking sheet in the oven and bake for about 30 minutes or until golden and set.

recipes.name: Blueberry ice cream
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 pounds frozen blueberries
3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk
1/2 teaspoon vanilla
recipes.instructions:
Put the ingredients into a blender.
Process until smooth, about 3 to 4 minutes. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Taco Dip
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups plain whole-milk yogurt
2 tbsp. taco seasoning
1 10-ounce can diced tomatoes with green chiles, like hot Rotel
1 cup shredded cheese
1/4 cup chopped cilantro

recipes.name: Boiled Cookies
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 C. granulated sugar
1/4 C. butter or margarine
1/8 t. salt
1 1/2 T. cocoa
1/4 C. milk
1 1/2 C. quick-cooking oatmeal
1/2 C. coconut
1/2 t. vanilla
1 C. chopped nuts
recipes.instructions:
Mix sugar, butter, salt, cocoa, and milk in a saucepan; bring to a boil, and boil for 1 minute.
Remove from heat and stir in oatmeal, coconut, vanilla, and nuts.
Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper and let cool until firm.

recipes.name: Broccoli Casserole
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb broccoli florets, chopped
1 (10.5-oz) can Cream of Mushroom soup
1 cup sour cream
2 Tbsp ranch dressing mix
1½ cups shredded cheddar cheese
½ cup cooked chopped bacon
1 (6-oz) container French fried onions
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350ºF. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with cooking spray.
Combine chopped broccoli, cream of mushroom soup, sour cream, ranch dressing mix, chopped bacon, 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese and 1/2 of the French fried onions.
Spread broccoli mixture into prepared pan.
Bake for 25 minutes. Remove from oven, top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake an additional 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Broccoli-Cheddar Butter Beans
recipes.ingredients:
1 tablespoon unsalted butter
½ cup finely chopped yellow onion
3 medium cloves garlic, finely chopped (about 1 tablespoon)
12 ounces fresh broccoli florets, cut into ½-inch pieces (about 4 cups)
⅓ cup lower-sodium vegetable broth
1 (15-ounce) can no-salt-added butter beans, rinsed
¾ cup half-and-half
½ teaspoon ground pepper
½ teaspoon dry mustard
½ teaspoon salt
1 cup shredded sharp Cheddar cheese, divided
8 (½-inch) slices crusty whole-wheat baguette, toasted
recipes.instructions:
Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add ½ cup onion and the chopped garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 2 minutes. Add cut broccoli, stirring until well combined. Pour in ⅓ cup broth; cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the broccoli is tender-crisp and bright green, 3 to 4 minutes.
Stir in rinsed beans, ¾ cup half-and-half and ½ teaspoon each pepper, dry mustard and salt. Bring to a lively simmer over medium-high heat. Simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the beans are warmed through and the sauce has thickened slightly, about 2 minutes. Let cool for 2 minutes, then stir in ¾ cup Cheddar until melted. Sprinkle with the remaining ¼ cup Cheddar. Serve with toasted baguette slices.

recipes.name: Chicken Lo Mein
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast, sliced
1 teaspoon pepper
1 teaspoon salt
2 teaspoons sesame oil, divided
¼ cup chicken broth
1 tablespoon soy sauce
1 tablespoon hoisin sauce
1 teaspoon cornstarch
1 tablespoon vegetable oil
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger
½ cup onion, sliced
½ cup carrot, sliced
½ cup sugar snap peas, halved
4 servings cooked egg noodles
1 tablespoon scallions, chopped, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
In a medium bowl, season the chicken with pepper, salt and 1 tablespoon of sesame oil. Mix thoroughly and set aside.
In a separate medium bowl, combine the chicken broth, remaining tablespoon of sesame oil, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, and cornstarch. Mix thoroughly and set aside.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until no longer pink inside, 3-4 minutes. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pan and cook until fragrant.
Add the onions, carrots, and sugar snap peas. Stir fry until the vegetables are tender.
Return the cooked chicken to the pan and add the cooked egg noodles and reserved sauce. Cook for 3 minutes, until everything is well-coated in the sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken Taquitos
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked shredded chicken (I use rotisserie)
6 ounces cream cheese , softened
1/4 cup salsa , your favorite kind
1/4 cup sour cream
1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
1 cup baby spinach leaves , chopped
1/4 teaspoon cumin
1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
1/4 teaspoon chili powder
salt and freshly ground black pepper for taste
15-20 corn or flour tortillas
For serving:
guacamole, sour cream, salsa, hot sauce
recipes.instructions:
Add cream cheese, salsa and sour cream to a mixing bowl and stir until smooth. Add remaining ingredients (except the tortillas) and toss to combine. Taste and add more seasoning, if needed.
For corn tortillas, heat a non-stick griddle over medium high heat. Cook tortillas for about 15 - 30 seconds on each side until soft and pliable. Remove tortillas to a plate covered with tinfoil to keep them warm and pliable.
Place a large spoonful of filling in a line along each tortilla and roll tightly. Secure with a toothpick if needed.
Baked Taquitos: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Spray the tops of the tacos with cooking spray , or brush them lightly with oil. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the shells are crispy.
Fried Taquitos: Add about 1 1/2 inches of oil to a large skillet and heat to medium-high. Once hot (the tortillas should sizzle immediately when added to the oil). Fry the taquitos in small batches, for a few seconds on each side, rotating them as they cook, until they are golden and crispy on all sides. Place them on a paper towel lined plate.
recipes.notes:
Make ahead Instructions: Make the filling up to 1 day in advance and store in the refrigerator.  Roll in tortillas before baking.
Freezing Instructions:  Taquitos make a great freezer meal.  Make the filling as instructed and roll up in tortillas. Place in a freezer ziplock bag and freeze for up to 3 months. Remove from freezer and place them on a lined or greased baking sheet. Cover with tinfoil and bake at 350 degrees for about 20 minutes. Uncover and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes or until warmed through and crisp on the outside.

recipes.name: Chili Verde
recipes.ingredients:
3 pounds boneless meat, half pork; the other half can be beef, elk, or some beef and some chicken/turkey
1 large bell pepper, chopped
1 large onion, chopped
2 large cloves of garlic, pressed or minced
2 large cans of tomatoes (1 lb, 12 ounces)(I like the chopped rather than whole)
¾ pound of fresh tomatillos (shucked, and either pureed or chopped small), or a regular can of tomatillos
2 x 7 ounce cans of California green chilis, chopped
⅓ C fresh chopped parsley
½ t sugar
¼ t ground cloves
2 t ground cumin
½ C red wine
¼ C lemon juice
½ C beef broth
½ t salt
½ t Hot Shot (red & black pepper)
recipes.instructions:
In a large stock pot, brown the cubed meat in olive oil, then remove the meat from the oil.
Now, in the same pan, saute over medium-low heat:
1 large green bell pepper, chopped
1 large onion, chopped
2 large cloves of garlic, pressed or minced
When the pepper/onion mixture is soft, add all the remaining ingredients.
Optional:
If you want it to be spicy, add either a can of diced tomatoes with peppers, or three fresh green Jalapeno peppers, diced (mix in with green peppers and onions); or wait till the very end and add Melinda's to taste (which you might need to do anyway, since it is hard to predict how spicy chilis will be).
If you leave out the wine, add a little more lemon or lime juice and beef broth
Put it all together in the large stock pot and simmer covered at least two hours over low heat, stirring occasionally. Then cook uncovered another hour or till it is the desired thickness and the meat is very tender.
Modifications
I usually don't make it exactly like the recipe anymore. Here's some of the changes I use, in various combinations.
Skip the tomatillos, and use all fresh tomatoes instead of canned.
Skip the canned peppers, and just use lots of fresh hot peppers, preferably colorful.
Untested: Substitute curry powder for the cumin and cloves

recipes.name: Chuck Roast in the Oven (Fall Apart)
recipes.ingredients:
5 pounds boneless chuck roast
1 Tablespoon olive oil
1 Tablespoon Morton kosher salt*
Fresh cracked black pepper
2 yellow onions, sliced, or bag of pearled onions
Bag of small potatoes
Bag of baby carrots
12 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup water
2 Tablespoons Worcestershire
recipes.instructions:
Prepare the Oven and Roast: Preheat broiler on high, placing rack 4–6 inches from heat. Put chuck roast on a broiler-safe pan, rub with olive oil, and season all sides generously with salt and pepper.
Broil the Roast: Broil 5–10 minutes until browned and crusty, watching closely to avoid burning.
Prepare for Baking: Lower oven to 300°F (150°C). Surround roast with onions, potatoes, and carrots. Sprinkle garlic on top, then pour water mixed with Worcestershire around (not over) the roast.
Bake the Roast: Cover tightly with foil or lid and bake at 300°F for 3 ½–4 hours, until fork-tender and easily shredded.
Rest and Serve: Let roast sit covered for 10 minutes, then shred and serve with vegetable and pan juices.

recipes.name: Jodi's Potato Salad
recipes.ingredients:
8 Potatoes, boiled, baked, or microwaved; may be peeled or not
6 Hard boiled eggs
1 cup Celery
1 medium Onion, diced
1 cup chopped Pickles or relish
5 cups Mayo or plain Greek yogurt
.25 cup Mustard
Salt
Paprika
recipes.instructions:
Chop potatoes, eggs, celery, onion, and pickles.
Add mayo and prepared mustard and salt to taste.
Toss and taste.
Decorate with some of the egg halves & paprika
Cover with plastic wrap so it doesn't flavor other foods.
Chill for 24 hours in the refrigerator for best flavor.

recipes.name: Vanilla Ice Cream
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups milk
1 3/4 cups sugar
1/2 teaspoon salt
2 cups half and half
1 tablespoon vanilla extract
4 cups whipping cream
Freezing:
Ice
Rock salt
recipes.instructions:
Scald the milk until bubbles form around the edge of the pan
Remove from heat and stir in sugar until dissolved
Add and stir together salt, vanilla, half and half and whipping cream
Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Pour into the ice cream maker and follow manufacturer directions until frozen.
Variations:
Strawberry: Add pureed strawberries (4 cups for 4 quart, 5 cups for quart, or 6 cups for 6 quart) to chilled mixture before freezing.
Banana: Add mashed bananas (3 cups for 4 quart, 3½ cups for 5 quart, or 4 cups for 6 quart) to the chilled mixture before freezing.
Peach: Add pureed peaches (4 cups for 4 quart, 5 cups for 5 quan 6 cups for 6 quart) to the chilled mixture before freezing.

recipes.name: Tortellini Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb Italian Sausage
3/4 cup white onion diced
2 stalks celery thinly sliced
2 medium carrots peeled, halved and sliced
6 cups chicken broth
28 ounce can crushed tomatoes
15 ounce can white beans drained and rinsed
19 ounce package refrigerated cheese tortellini
3 cups baby spinach
2 tablespoons chopped parsley
recipes.instructions:
Cook the Italian sausage in a large pot until browned and cooked through. Drain excess grease if needed.
Add the onion, celery, and carrots. Sauté until the vegetables begin to soften.
Add the chicken broth and crushed tomatoes. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Add the white beans and tortellini. Cook according to tortellini package directions until tender.
Stir in the baby spinach and parsley. Cook until the spinach wilts.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Apple Pie
recipes.ingredients:
Pastry for 1 (9-inch) 2-crust pie
6 to 7 cups sliced, peeled apples (6 to 7 medium apples)
3/4 to 1 cup sugar
2 tablespoons flour
1/2 to 1 teaspoon cinnamon
1/8 teaspoon nutmeg
1/8 teaspoon salt
2 tablespoons butter
recipes.instructions:
Use Pastry Made with Solid Fat, Pastry Made with Oil or Beginner's Pastry for a 2-crust pie. Mix pastry by recipe directions. Form it into a ball and cut it in half with a knife. Roll the bottom crust and line a 9-inch pie pan with it, as the directions tell you. Put the pastry-lined pan in the refrigerator while you fix the filling. Set the other half of the pastry aside.
Cut apples in quarters, cut out the cores and cut the apples into slices 1/4 inch thick. Place them in a large bowl.
Stir the sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt to- gether to mix well. (The amount of sugar-3/4 to 1 cup -you need to add depends on the tartness of the apples, and the amount of cinnamon-1/2 to 1 teaspoon-depends on how spicy you like apple pie.) Add the mixture to the apple slices and toss with 2 forks to mix well.
Start heating the oven to 425° F.
Roll the other half of the pastry for the top crust and cut small vents in it.
Place the apple mixture in the pastry-lined pie pan and spread it evenly. Dot it with butter.
Cover the apples with the top crust. Gently press the top and bottom crusts together. Then fold the edge of the lower crust over the edge of the top crust. Use a fork to make a pretty design on the edge of the pie, or flute edge with a pinch and twist of your thumb and forefinger. Then cover the edge of the pie with a 1/2-inch strip of aluminum foil to prevent it from browning too much. (Remove the foil after the pie is baked.)
Bake on the rack in the center of the oven 50 to 60 minutes or until the crust is browned. Cool the pie on a wire rack. Serve it warm or cold. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.name: German Pancakes
recipes.ingredients:
4 Tbs. butter or margarine
6 eggs
1 C. flour
1 C. milk
¼ tsp. salt
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 450°F
Put 2 Tbs. butter in each of two pie pans; melt as oven preheats.
In a bowl, combine eggs, flour, milk, and salt; beat until fluffy and smooth.
Pour half of batter in each pan
Bake at 450°F for 20 minutes. Pancakes will puff up.

recipes.name: Oatmeal Cookies
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/4 Cup (2-1/2 sticks) margarine or butter, softened
3/4 Cup firmly packed brown sugar
1/2 Cup granulated sugar
1 Egg
1 Teaspoon vanilla
1 1/2 Cup all-purpose flour
1 Teaspoon Baking Soda
1 Teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/2 Teaspoon salt
1/4 Teaspoon ground nutmeg
3 Cup Oats (quick or old fashioned, uncooked)
recipes.instructions:
Heat oven to 375°F.
In large bowl, beat margarine and sugars until creamy.
Add egg and vanilla; beat well.
Add combined flour, baking soda, cinnamon, salt and nutmeg; mix well.
Add oats; mix well.
Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake 8 to 9 minutes for a chewy cookie or 10 to 11 minutes for a crisp cookie.
Cool 1 minute on cookie sheets; remove to wire rack.
Cool completely.
Store tightly covered.

recipes.name: Baked Apple Fritters
recipes.ingredients:
1 cups Flour
1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
1/4 teaspoon salt
¼ cup Sugar
¾ cup Cinnamon Applesauce if plain, add 2 tsp. cinnamon (note 3)
1 cup Green Apple Cubes peeled, cored, diced in small cubes
Glazing:
3/4 cups Confectioners Sugar
1-1½  tablespoons Milk
½ teaspoon Vanilla Extract
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 400 °F (200 °C).
Line two large baking sheets with silicone mats or baking paper that are safe for use with an oven broiler. You can also use the baking sheet directly, but it gets hard to clean. Oil the paper generously with cooking oil. Set aside.
In a mixing bowl, add flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon (if your applesauce is not cinnamon-flavored), and sugar. Whisk to combine.
Fold in applesauce and stir until it forms a thick, moist batter. Don't over-mix.
Fold in chopped apples and stir to incorporate evenly.
Drop heaping tablespoons of batter on the baking sheet, leaving a thumb space between each fritter. Don't make big fritters; for the best texture, keep them small.
Place it in the center rack of the oven, one baking sheet at a time, keeping the second one on the kitchen countertop while the first one bakes. Bake the fritters for 18-21 minutes or until nicely golden brown.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and turn the oven to broiler 420 °F (210 °C)—no more, as baking paper can't handle broiler over 425 °F!
Meanwhile, make the glazing, stir icing sugar, vanilla extract, and almond milk.
For crispy baked apple fritters, brush a little bit of the glazing on top of each warm fritter and broil on the top rack of the oven for 2-3 minutes, keeping a close eye on them so they don't burn.
When golden brown, remove from the oven. Let them cool for 10 minutes on a rack, then dip them in the glaze and return them to the rack to let the excess glazing drip down.

recipes.name: French Onion Meatballs
recipes.ingredients:
2 T. Olive oil
1 bag party sized meatballs (20 oz)
1 serving French Onion Soup
5 C. beef broth
1 T. Worcestershire
2 t each garlic powder and onion powder
1 t each salt and pepper
Corn starch slurry (1 T. corn starch, 1 T. cold water mixed together)
1-2 C. swiss & gruyere cheese blend
Optional Items:
thinly sliced yellow onion, crispy fried onions, chopped fresh parsley for garnish.
recipes.instructions:
Add olive oil, (fresh onions if using.) french onion soup, meatballs, seasonings, beef broth and Worcestershire to a crockpot.
Add in the cornstarch slurry if you want the sauce to be thicker.
Turn crockpot to high and let cook for 30 more minutes.
Switch the crockpot to warm, layer on the cheese and cover with the lid until cheese is melted (about 10 minutes.)
Top with parsley and crispy fried onions (optional but recommended!)
I served ours over an easy parmesan cream sauce orzo that I made after the cornstarch slurry was added. These could be delicious over rice, or mashed potatoes

recipes.name: No-Bake Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Snacks
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp Honey
1/4 cup Peanut butter
1/2 cup Quick oats
1/4 cup Chocolate chips, mini

recipes.name: Easy No Bake Strawberry Cream Pie
recipes.ingredients:
1 (9-inch) graham cracker crust
1 package cream cheese, softened
½ cup powdered sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 container whipped topping
1 cup fresh strawberries, puréed
½ cup strawberry jelly or jam
Extra whipped topping

recipes.name: Banana Cream Pie
recipes.ingredients:
1 pre-baked pie crust
3 cups whole milk
½ cup granulated sugar
½ cup cornstarch
½ tsp salt
4 large egg yolks
2 tbsp unsalted butter
2 tsp vanilla extract
3-4 ripe bananas, sliced
1 cup heavy cream
2 tbsp powdered sugar
1 tsp vanilla (optional)

recipes.name: Chicken And Fried Rice
recipes.ingredients:
Chicken:
2 chicken breasts (cut into cubes)
1 tsp olive oil
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
1/2 tsp black pepper
1 tbsp soy sauce
Egg fried rice:
1 cup mixed veg (i used frozen peas, carrots, sweet corn, green beans)
1/2 chopped onion
2 whole eggs + egg whites if needed
200g cooked white rice (use more if needed
1 tbsp soy sauce
recipes.instructions:
Mix till well combined
Cook on medium high heat, 4 mins each side till golden brown then set aside
Give it a final mix and serve!

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Mac and Cheese
recipes.ingredients:
8 oz dry higher fiber macaroni elbows
1 cup cottage cheese
⅓ cup milk
⅓ cup nutritional yeast
1 cup cheddar cheese shredded
¼ teaspoon garlic powder
⅛ teaspoon paprika
¼ teaspoon black pepper
⅛ teaspoon onion powder
2 tablespoon pasta water
1 tablespoon corn starch
recipes.instructions:
Cook pasta according to the package directions (don’t forget to salt the water), drain and set aside. Remember to reserve 2 tablespoon of water for later.
To a blender, add cottage cheese, milk, nutritional yeast, cheese, garlic powder, paprika, black pepper, and onion powder and blend until smooth.
In a small dish, whisk together reserved pasta water and cornstarch.
Add cheese sauce to a small pan over medium heat until it reaches a simmer. Add cornstarch + water mixture to the sauce, and stir. Cook until the sauce begins to thicken- about 5 minutes. To avoid burning the sauce- continue to stir (See notes below for tips)! Stir in additional cheese if needed!
Add pasta directly to the sauce, stir and enjoy!

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Fondue Recipe
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup full-fat cottage cheese
3/4 cup shredded Swiss cheese
3/4 cup shredded Gruyère cheese
1 tsp tapioca starch or cornstarch
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1/4 tsp salt, or to taste
1 garlic clove, halved (optional)
recipes.instructions:
Prepare the double boiler. Place a heatproof bowl over a pot of gently simmering water.
Blend the cottage cheese. In a blender or food processor, blend the cottage cheese until it is completely smooth and no curds remain.
Combine the cheeses. In a small bowl, toss the shredded Swiss and Gruyère cheeses with the tapioca starch until evenly coated. This prevents clumping and helps the cheese melt smoothly.
Melt the cheese mixture. Add the blended cottage cheese, half of the shredded Swiss, and half of the shredded Gruyère to the double boiler. Stir continuously until the cheese is fully melted.
Add seasonings. Stir in the Dijon mustard, salt, and remaining shredded cheese. Continue stirring until the mixture is smooth and fully melted.
Transfer and serve. Rub the inside of a fondue pot with the cut garlic clove (if using), then discard the clove. Pour the fondue into the pot to keep it warm over a low heat source.
Dipping ideas
Bread: Cubes of French bread, pumpernickel, or rye
Vegetables: Roasted potatoes, roasted broccoli, roasted asparagus, bell pepper strips, or cherry tomatoes
Fruit: Sliced green apples or pears
Meat: Cubes of cooked turkey, ham, or roast beef

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Queso Dip
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup cottage cheese
2 tablespoons taco seasoning
1/2 cup shredded Pepper Jack cheese
For serving: 
salsa or diced tomatoes
tortilla chips
recipes.instructions:
In a blender or food processor, combine cottage cheese and taco seasoning, blending on high until smooth.
Transfer the mixture into a microwave-safe bowl and stir in Pepper Jack cheese.
Microwave until the cheese is melted, about 90 seconds.
Remove from microwave and stir until cheese is well combined.
Top with salsa or diced tomatoes if desired, and serve while hot with your favorite tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Cranberry Apple Crisp
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups chopped unpeeled apples
2 cups raw cranberries
1 1/4 cups Extra Fine Granulated Sugar
1 1/2 cups uncooked quick-cooking oats
1/2 cup Light Brown Sugar
1/2 cup all-purpose flour
1/2 cup chopped pecans
1/2 cup melted butter
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350°F.
Combine apples, cranberries and granulated sugar in a 2 quart casserole dish.
In a separate bowl, combine oats, brown sugar, flour, pecans, and butter.
Top fruit mixture with oat mixture. Bake one hour until bubbly and light brown.
Serve hot with turkey or ham or as a dessert with vanilla ice cream.

recipes.name: Cream of Soup Mix
recipes.ingredients:
4 cups powdered milk ÷ 12 = 1/3 cup
1 1/2 cups cornstarch ÷ 12 = 2 Tbsp
1/2 cup chicken bouillon ÷ 12 =  2 tsp
4 tsp onion powder ÷ 12 = 1/4 tsp
2 tsp dried basil ÷ 12 = 1/4 tsp
1 tsp dried thyme ÷ 12 = pinch
1 tsp garlic powder ÷ 12 = pinch
1 tsp pepper ÷ 12 = pinch
recipes.instructions:
Over low heat add 1 cup milk or water and 1/3 cup of dry mix, whisk until your mixture is smooth and thickened.
Cream of broccoli - add 1/2 cup finely chopped broccoli
Cream of cheddar - add 1/2 cup cheddar cheese
Cream of chicken add 1/2 cup finely chopped cooked chicken breast
Cream of mushroom - add 1/2 cup finely chopped mushrooms
Cream of celery add 1/2 cup finely diced celery

recipes.name: Crispy Bean and Beef Taquitos
recipes.ingredients:
Taquitos:
4 tbsp avocado oil
1 lb grass-fed ground beef
1/2 pack taco seasoning
1 can refried beans
Mini tortillas
Toppings / Dips:
Cilantro
Avocado
Guacamole
Dairy-free sour cream
Salsa
Dairy-free queso
recipes.instructions:
Heat a medium skillet with 1/2 tbsp avocado oil on medium to high heat. Add ground beef to brown, then add taco seasoning. Stir and reduce heat to low for 5 minutes.
While the beef is cooking, in a small saucepan, heat refried beans.
On a cutting board, lay out the tortillas. Add a small spoonful of beans to spread thin on each tortilla, then a spoonful of the cooked ground beef to cover the entire tortilla. Roll the tortilla as tight as possible, then place seam-side down on the cutting board.
In a large skillet, add remaining avocado oil to heat on medium. Make sure there’s enough oil in the pan, you may need to add more throughout. Once oil is hot, add all rolled Taquitos seam-side down and let brown on all sides, about 4-5 minutes per side.
Top and serve with desired toppings and dips. Enjoy!
Baked Taquitos: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Spray the tops of the tacos with cooking spray , or brush them lightly with oil. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the shells are crispy.

recipes.name: French Bread Pizza
recipes.ingredients:
1 (14 oz) loaf French bread (about 17-inches long, 4-inches wide*)
1/4 cup olive oil
1 cup (scant) pizza sauce, preferably homemade, or store-bought
1 3/4 cups (7 oz) shredded mozzarella cheese
1/4 cup finely shredded parmesan cheese
Desired toppings:
Olives
Ham
Sausage
Bell pepper
Onion
Pineapple
recipes.instructions:
Move oven rack up one level and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Line a rimmed 18 by 13-inch baking sheet with aluminum foil for easier clean up if desired.
Cut french bread in half evenly through the length, to create two long portions. Cut each portion in half (creating four pieces total) and place them on baking sheet.
Brush both sides with olive oil. Turn upright and bake in preheated oven 4 minutes.
Spread pizza sauce over each piece, sprinkle evenly with mozzarella and parmesan cheeses, then finish with desired toppings.
Bake in preheated oven until cheese is fully melted, about 10- 13 minutes. If you'd like it more browned then broil during the last 1 minute or so (keep a close eye on it!).

recipes.name: Stir-Fried Beef and Noodles with Vegetables
recipes.ingredients:
1 pound top sirloin steak or flank steak, thinly sliced
1 tablespoon low-sodium soy sauce
1 tablespoon cornstarch
1 teaspoon sesame oil
1 teaspoon baking soda (optional, for extra tenderness)
1 tablespoon vegetable oil
3 tablespoons low-sodium soy sauce
2 tablespoons oyster sauce
1 tablespoon hoisin sauce
1 tablespoon chili garlic sauce (adjust to taste)
1 teaspoon sugar
1 teaspoon sesame oil
12 ounces flat rice or wheat noodles
3 tablespoons vegetable oil, divided
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tablespoon fresh ginger, minced
1 red chili, thinly sliced
2 medium bell peppers, cut into 1-inch pieces
3 green onions, sliced, plus extra for garnish
Sesame seeds, optional, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Marinating the Beef 🥩:
Begin by preparing the beef. In a bowl, combine the soy sauce, cornstarch, sesame oil, and baking soda if using. Add the sliced beef and toss until each piece is evenly coated. Let it marinate for about 15 minutes. This short marinating time helps tenderize the meat and creates a light coating that will thicken the sauce during cooking.Beef
Preparing the Noodles 🍜
Cook the noodles according to the package instructions until just tender. Drain them well and rinse briefly under cold water to stop the cooking process. Set aside until ready to use.
Mixing the Sauce 🥣
In a small bowl, whisk together all the sauce ingredients. Taste and adjust the chili garlic sauce depending on how spicy you like your stir-fry.
Stir-Frying the Beef 🔥
Heat one tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat. Add the marinated beef in a single layer and cook quickly, about one to two minutes per side, until browned and just cooked through. Remove the beef from the pan and set aside.
Cooking the Vegetables and Noodles 🫑
Add another tablespoon of oil to the same wok. Stir-fry the garlic, ginger, and red chili for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the bell peppers and cook for two to three minutes, keeping them tender-crisp.
Push the vegetables aside, add the remaining oil, then add the noodles. Pour the sauce over the noodles and return the beef to the pan. Toss everything together until well coated and heated through.

recipes.name: Apple Crunch
recipes.ingredients:
1 pkg. JIFFY Muffin Mix
9 cups apples, peeled and sliced
1/2 cup sugar
1 tsp. cinnamon
3/4 cup quick oats
3/4 cup brown sugar, firmly packed
1/2 cup butter, softened
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a 13" x 9" baking pan. Combine apples, sugar and cinnamon. Mix to coat and place in pan. Combine muffin mix, oats and brown sugar.
Cut in butter until crumbly.
Sprinkle on top of apples.
Bake 40-45 minutes

recipes.name: Brownies
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
3/4 cup all-purpose flour
2/3 cup cocoa powder, sifted if lumpy
1/2 cup powdered sugar, sifted if lumpy
1/2 cup dark chocolate chips
3/4 teaspoons sea salt
2 large eggs
1/2 cup canola oil or extra-virgin olive oil
2 tablespoons water
1/2 teaspoon vanilla
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 325°F. Lightly spray an 8x8 baking dish (not a 9x9 dish or your brownies will overcook) with cooking spray and line it with parchment paper. Spray the parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, combine the sugar, flour, cocoa powder, powdered sugar, chocolate chips, and salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, olive oil, water, and vanilla.
Sprinkle the dry mix over the wet mix and stir until just combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared pan (it'll be thick - that's ok) and use a spatula to smooth the top. Bake for 40 to 48 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out with only a few crumbs attached (note: it's better to pull the brownies out early than to leave them in too long). Cool completely before slicing.

recipes.name: Big Fat Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookies
recipes.ingredients:
1 and 1/2 cups (188g) all-purpose flour (spooned & leveled)
1 teaspoon baking powder
1 teaspoon baking soda
1 teaspoon salt
1 cup (16 Tbsp; 226g) unsalted butter, softened to room temperature
1 cup (200g) granulated sugar
1/2 cup (100g) packed light or dark brown sugar
2 large eggs, at room temperature
1 cup (240g) creamy peanut butter
2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract
2 cups (170g) old-fashioned whole rolled oats
2 and 1/2 cups (450g) semi-sweet chocolate chips, plus more for topping if desired
recipes.instructions:
Whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together in a medium bowl. Set aside.
In a large bowl using a hand mixer or a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, beat the butter on medium-high speed until smooth, about 1 minute. Add the granulated sugar and brown sugar and beat on medium-high speed until creamed, about 2 minutes. Add the eggs, peanut butter, and vanilla and beat on high speed until combined, about 1 minute. Scrape down the sides and up the bottom of the bowl and beat again as needed to combine.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix on low until combined. With the mixer running on low speed, add the oats. Once combined, beat in the chocolate chips. Dough will be thick and sticky. Cover and chill the dough for at least 20 minutes in the refrigerator (and up to 4 days). If chilling for longer than 1 hour, allow to sit at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before rolling and baking because the dough will be quite hard.
Preheat oven to 350°F (177°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper or silicone baking mats. Set aside.
Scoop balls of dough, 2 Tablespoons of dough per cookie, and arrange 3 inches apart on the baking sheets. Bake for 12-14 minutes until lightly browned on the sides. The centers will look very soft.
Remove from the oven and allow to cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. While the cookies are still warm, I like to press a few more chocolate chips into the tops—this is only for looks!
Cookies stay fresh covered at room temperature for up to 1 week.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Drops
recipes.ingredients:
1/4 C. butter or margarine
1/4 C. milk
1 C. granulated sugar
1/4 C. peanut butter
1/2 t. vanilla
2 C. quick-cooking oatmeal
recipes.instructions:
Mix butter, sugar, and milk in a saucepan; bring to a boil, and boil for 1 minute.
Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter, vanilla, and oatmeal.
Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper and chill in the refrigerator until firm.

recipes.name: Quick & Easy Refrigerator Pickles
recipes.ingredients:
1¼ cups distilled white vinegar (5% acidity)
3 tablespoons kosher salt
2 tablespoons sugar
2 cups cold water
1¾ to 2 pounds Kirby cucumbers (about 6), cut into halves or spears
2 tablespoons coriander seeds
6 large garlic cloves, peeled and halved
1 teaspoon mustard seeds
¼ teaspoon red pepper flakes
16 dill sprigs
recipes.instructions:
Combine the water, salt and sugar in a small non-reactive saucepan (such as stainless steel, glass, ceramic or teflon) over high heat. Whisk until the salt and sugar are dissolved. Transfer the liquid into a bowl and whisk in the vinegar.
Refrigerate brine until ready to use.
Stuff the cucumbers into two clean 1-quart jars.
Add the coriander seeds, garlic cloves, mustard seeds, red pepper flakes, dill sprigs, and chilled brine into jars, dividing evenly. If necessary, add a bit of cold water to the jars until the brine covers the cucumbers.
Cover and refrigerate for about 24 hours, then serve. The pickles will keep in the refrigerator for up to one month.

recipes.name: Easy Blueberry Hand Pies
recipes.ingredients:
1 package refrigerated pie crusts (2 crusts)
2 cups blueberries — fresh or frozen
⅓ cup sugar
1 tablespoon cornstarch
1 tablespoon lemon juice
½ teaspoon vanilla
Pinch of salt
1 egg + 1 tablespoon water, beaten (for egg wash)
Coarse sugar, optional
recipes.instructions:
Make the filling
Put blueberries, sugar, cornstarch, lemon juice, vanilla, and salt in a small saucepan.
Cook over medium heat for about 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the berries burst and the mixture thickens.
Let it cool for 10–15 minutes.
Make the pies
Unroll the pie crusts and cut into roughly 4–5 inch circles. A bowl or large biscuit cutter works.
Put a spoonful of blueberry filling in the center of each.
Fold over into a half-moon and press the edges with a fork.
Cut 1–2 small slits in the top.
Brush with egg wash and sprinkle with sugar if you want.
Bake
400°F for about 18–22 minutes, until golden brown.
Let them cool for at least 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Baked Krusteaz Cinnamon Sugar Donuts
recipes.ingredients:
Krusteaz Pancake Mix: 1 ½ cups
Water:  ¾ cup
Butter: 4 tablespoons (melted)
Granulated Sugar: ½ cup
Ground Cinnamon: 1 tablespoon
recipes.instructions:
Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Lightly grease your 6-cavity donut tin with non-stick cooking spray.
In a medium bowl, combine the 1 ½ cups of Krusteaz mix with the water. Stir until you have a smooth, thick cake-like batter with no large dry pockets.
Spoon the batter evenly into the 6 donut cavities. Fill each cavity about ¾ full. If the batter is still a bit stubborn, smooth the tops slightly with the back of a damp spoon so they bake evenly.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes. They are done when they are lightly golden on top, puffed up, and spring back when you gently press the surface.
Let the donuts cool in the pan for 2 to 3 minutes, then pop them out onto a plate while they are still warm. Dip each donut into the melted butter (or brush it on), then immediately press it into the cinnamon-sugar mix until fully coated.
